name: The Incredibles: Jack-Jack's Escape
storyline:
As The Incredibles fight off the sinister Underminer and his Drillbots, their youngest member has found his way into the Underminer's Drill Base!

Jack-Jack cheerfully makes his way through the base, leaving a trail of fiery destruction in his wake. Will he escape the machine and be united with his heroic family?
summary: Heroic Baby Hijinx! The game takes place within the Underminer’s colossal digger. You control Jack-Jack, the infant member of the Incredibles. A Disney game.
